newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 8.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Founding member of Ivorian-dominated Africa Bell consortium, Koffi Bergson, says entry of AT&T into its capital lifts threat of disqualification from race to take majority stake in state telecommunications company CI-TELCOM; says privatisation committee has been coming under pressure to block its bid; bids to be opened Thursday
- Calm start to university year in Ivory Coast
- Shanty towns in Abidjan's smart residential district of Cocody to be removed from February 6; government says such make-shift settlements often shelter bandits
- Ivorian government reshuffle likely with President Henri Konan Bedie looking to bring in opposition members
- Ivorian government allows sale of pork once again following ban imposed to curb outbreak of African swine fever, which killed most pigs in and around commercial capital Abidjan.

- Ivorian insurance company Nouvelle Societe Interafricaine d'Assurances NSIA takes stake in Africa Bell consortium which is bidding for majority stake in Ivory Coast's state telecommunications company CI-TELCOM
- Three students jailed for two years for inciting violence and public order offences
- Ivory Coast projects 250,000 tourist arrivals in 1997 compared to 235,000 in 1996, senior official responsible for tourism says
